rows: First double-entry ledger?
Farolfi company, Florence, 1299; Pacioli published description 1494
What was the 4-party bill structure?
Remitter, Drawer, Drawee, Payee; only paper moved; silver stayed put
How did bills solve the usury problem?
Return embedded in exchange rate spread, not called interest
Why did the Bardi/Peruzzi banks fail?
Edward III of England defaulted on war loans, ~1343-1346
What made the Medici branch system innovative?
Each branch was a legally separate company; limited cross-branch contagion
What was the Monte Comune?
Florence's public debt (1345): forced loans, tradeable bonds, price signal
Why did limited liability matter?
Enabled small investors to participate without risk of ruin; prerequisite for capital markets
What caused the price revolution?
Spanish American silver tripled European money supply; quantity theory (Bodin 1568)
Who won and lost in the price revolution?
Winners: merchants, debtors; Losers: fixed-rent landlords, creditors, Church
What is the Wisselbank's modern analog?
Clearing house plus reserve bank; Amsterdam 1609; model for Bank of England 1694
